description: Five-star golden-hour downtown chase: Mara flat out through the intersection, two patrol cars on her bumper, Air One overhead, fourteen cars packing the avenues, twenty pedestrians on the sidewalks, Hot Delivery objective, HUD and minimap live.

Five-star police ram run at 80+ km/h during the Hot Delivery job: three patrol cars ramming, a three-car roadblock sealing the road ahead, Air One overhead, traffic scattering, 5-STAR RAM RUN warning on the HUD.

On-foot Turf War shootout by the casino at golden hour: Mara firing her pistol, three Crows gang members charging her, two patrol cars converging with light bars flashing, pedestrians fleeing, muzzle flash and tracer live.

Neon storm night downtown at 22:00: rain and lightning, Mara's car at the intersection, eight cars with headlights, pedestrians on the sidewalks, two patrol cars flashing, Air One pinning its searchlight on the street, towers lit behind.
